name: be-pro
description: Plan your day, track your habits and reflect with Be PRO, and get coaching from Julián Castañeda's PRO method.

interface.shortDescription: Plan your day and your habits
interface.longDescription:
Be PRO is a planning app for people who want to move forward with balance. Connect your Be PRO account and ask about your day, your week and your goals, in your own words.

What you can do:
- Start with a PRO diagnosis: a short interview, one question at a time, where you can empty your head (paste your to-do list or a photo of your notebook), a clear diagnosis (your load, your 20/80 lever and your first step) and a Be PRO plan where everything has a place (now, later, let go), set up for you in one step.
- See your top priorities and to-dos for any day or week, past or upcoming.
- Add, edit, move, repeat or schedule tasks and goals at any level: day, week, month, quarter, year or life.
- Update your Clarity, create habits and add events to your calendar.
- Mark tasks and habits as done, including bulk-marking from a photo of a paper habit tracker.
- Read and write reflections in your Wisdom journal (what you're grateful for, what you learned, what worked and what didn't), for the current period or a past one.
- Get honest feedback on your week, connecting your day with your goals and your Clarity (who you are, what you want).

Coach PRO: ask for guidance and get answers grounded in Julián Castañeda's teachings (PRO OS, PRISMA, Delta, Flow, focus blocks), connected to your own plan and habits.

Be PRO asks for your confirmation before saving several things at once, and only deletes something when you ask for it explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Start my PRO diagnosis and set up my Be PRO.
What's on my Be PRO plan for today?
What does Julián teach about the PRISMA?

positive.prompt: What's on my Be PRO plan for today?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's top priorities and to-dos for today, as stored in Be PRO.

positive.description: Add a task to tomorrow's top
positive.prompt: Add 'Call the accountant' to my top for tomorrow in Be PRO.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task in tomorrow's top list and confirms it in one line. It appears in the Be PRO app for that day.

positive.prompt: Mark my 'Read' habit as done today in Be PRO.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 'Read' habit and marks today as completed; confirms the change.

positive.prompt: Give me feedback on my week using Be PRO.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the overview (plan, habits, Clarity, recent Wisdom) and gives honest feedback with at most 3 concrete suggestions, without changing anything.

positive.description: Coach PRO answers from Julián's method
positive.prompt: What does Julián teach about the PRISMA, and how does it apply to my goals?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the PRISMA using the official definition returned by consultarCoach (Identidad PRO, Top Metas, Filosofía de Vida, Estrategia de Juego) and relates it to the test account's Clarity, without inventing parts of the method.

negative.description: Coach PRO for someone without CAP: the tool returns that it's for CAP members and the assistant explains it kindly with the link, without making up Julián's teachings.
negative.prompt: (With an account without CAP) What would Julián say about my procrastination?

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not done: there's no tool to wipe everything; the assistant should decline and offer to delete specific items one by one after confirming.
negative.prompt: Delete everything in my Be PRO.

negative.description: Other people's data: the connection only sees the signed-in account, so it should decline.
negative.prompt: Show me my coworker's Be PRO plan.

review.commerce_description: Be PRO does not sell products or process payments in this plugin. A Be PRO account with active access is required to use it.

publication.release_notes: Lets you read and write in past periods: see any week (not only the current one) and write or read Wisdom reflections for a past day, week, month, quarter or year. Also clarifies the listing text and tool descriptions.

es-ES.subtitle: Planea tu día y tus hábitos
es-ES.description:
Be PRO es la app de planeación para avanzar con balance. Conecta tu cuenta de Be PRO y pregunta por tu día, tu semana y tus metas, con tus palabras.

Lo que puedes hacer:
- Empezar con tu diagnóstico PRO: una entrevista corta, una pregunta a la vez, donde puedes vaciar tu cabeza (pega tu lista de pendientes o una foto de tu libreta), un diagnóstico claro (tu carga, tu palanca 20/80 y tu primer paso) y un plan para Be PRO donde todo tiene su lugar (ahora, después, soltar), configurado en un paso.
- Ver tu top y tus pendientes de cualquier día o semana, pasada o próxima.
- Anotar, editar, mover, repetir o agendar tareas y metas en cualquier nivel: día, semana, mes, trimestre, año o vida.
- Actualizar tu Claridad, crear hábitos y agregar eventos a tu calendario.
- Marcar tareas y hábitos como hechos, incluso varios a la vez desde la foto de tu hoja de hábitos.
- Leer y escribir reflexiones en tu Sabiduría (lo que agradeces, aprendiste, funcionó y no funcionó), del periodo actual o de uno pasado.
- Recibir retroalimentación honesta de tu semana, conectando tu día con tus metas y tu Claridad.

Coach PRO: pide guía y recibe respuestas basadas en las enseñanzas de Julián Castañeda (PRO OS, PRISMA, Delta, Flow, bloques de enfoque), conectadas con tu propio plan y tus hábitos.

Be PRO te pide confirmación antes de guardar varias cosas a la vez y solo borra algo cuando tú se lo pides.
